effects.issue: EVENT_MOVE does not identify whether movement into a Deck was a shuffle, and it cannot reliably cover cost-based or rule-based shuffles. The current REASON_EFFECT tracker is only an approximation. Resolution: rewrite the condition as 'If your Stain monster was moved into a Deck by a card effect this turn', or add a core shuffle event/reason and use it in c232449539.lua.
